text:
eva: quick tidy: novus-13b bring-up cost/quality snapshot (4k sampled dialogue slices). short summary + conservative rollout proposal for GTN/product.

sam: pls drop the numbers and the key failure slices.

eva: numbers below:
Model: novus13b-int6
p50 latency: 195ms, p95: 460ms
avg tokens/req: 520
cost / 1M toks: $20.30
GTN multi-turn: 0.89

Model: novus13b-int5 (hybrid quant)
p50 latency: 205ms, p95: 500ms
avg tokens/req: 520
cost / 1M toks: $13.60
GTN multi-turn: 0.86

Model: novus13b-int4
p50 latency: 245ms, p95: 720ms
avg tokens/req: 520
cost / 1M toks: $8.90
GTN multi-turn: 0.81

kai: ok that is ~56% cost reduction going int4 from int6, int5 is the middle ground at ~33% savings. where's the quality delta coming from?

eva: regressions concentrated on: long-context recall (>900 tokens), multi-step instruction sequences (2+ dependent steps), and small structured outputs (tables). short chit-chat and single-turn Q/A look parity.

tasha: product ask: we have both consumer and enterprise flows; any routing that balances UX and savings?

eva: proposed conservative strategy:
- Default route: novus-int5 (hybrid quant) to capture majority of savings with smaller quality hit.
- Promote to int6 for requests where: context_tokens > 900 OR user_tier == enterprise OR request_type in ["financial_advice","legal_summaries"].
- Allow int4 for low-cost preview tier and cached recall queries where we can post-filter.
- Canary: start 2% -> 15% over 10d; require shadowing and daily GTN diffs.

sam: expected unit-econ for mixed rules?

eva: back-of-envelope: all-int6 = $20.3. all-int5 = $13.6. all-int4 = $8.9. if we do 60% int5 + 30% int6 + 10% int4 => cost = 0.6*13.6 + 0.3*20.3 + 0.1*8.9 = ~$14.39 / 1M (~29% vs all-int6). If routing pins 25% to int6 (enterprise+long) and rest split int5/int4 -> ~$15.12 / 1M (~25% savings).

kai: good. gating? what slices must pass before ramp to 15%?

eva: gating checklist:
- GTN must-pass slices: "multi-step-instruction" and "long-context-recall" (set soft-fail threshold at -0.02 GTN delta).
- Add structured-output parser tests (schema checker) during canary; fail-open to int6 on parsing failure rate > 1%.
- 48h shadow on top-4 product flows, plus manual spot checks on 50 failed examples.
- Rollback flag: feature-flag toggles to immediate 100% int6.

tasha: GTM blurb for deck? keep it short.

eva: GTM line: "Novus-13b hybrid quant (int5) offers ~33% per-token savings with minimal quality impact; recommend hybrid-by-default plus enterprise/long-context routing to preserve fidelity while achieving ~25-30% unit-cost reduction."

sam: add routing examples to the model docs and show p95 latency and GTN tradeoffs. also include short examples of the failed slices so product sees the UX delta.

eva: will upload per-slice CSV, sample transcripts, and a short triage note to the onboarding folder by EOD. raw requests available on request. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary flag registered: `novus13b-hybrid-canary` -> default 0.02. Runbook: /run rollout-canary novus13b 2% -> 15% over 10d. audit created at 1745553333.
